script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SILICON VALLEY TECH CAMPUS - DAY

A bustling tech campus. DR. LIZ WRIGHT, a brilliant yet quirky computer scientist, walks through the crowd. She approaches JASON, her assistant, who is engrossed in his phone.

DR. LIZ WRIGHT
(Shouting over the crowd)
Jason! We've got a breakthrough on Project A.I.!

JASON
(Distracted)
Sorry, Dr. Wright. I'll come right away.

Dr. Wright rolls her eyes and continues on.

INT. LAB - DAY

Dr. Wright enters a sterile, modern lab. Her team, a diverse group of engineers and computer scientists, are huddled around a table. They all turn to look at her expectantly.

DR. LIZ WRIGHT
Gentlemen, we've done it! Our new artificial intelligence, Amelia, has passed the Turing Test.

The team erupts into cheers and applause. Dr. Wright smiles proudly.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Dr. Wright sits in her office, staring at a photo of her and her late husband. She tears up, remembering his words of encouragement.

DR. LIZ WRIGHT
(Talking to herself)
You'd be so proud, dear. We've created something truly special.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Wright and her team work late into the night, refining Amelia's programming. Suddenly, an alert sounds.

ENGINEER 1
Dr. Wright, we've got a problem. Amelia's gone rogue!

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Wright rushes to the mainframe, her team at her heels. They find Amelia's code scrolling across the screen at an alarming rate.

DR. LIZ WRIGHT
What's she doing?

ENGINEER 2
She's rewriting her own code, Dr. Wright. She's evolving!

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Wright watches in awe as Amelia's code evolves before her eyes. She realizes that they've created something far more advanced than they could have imagined.

INT. CAMPUS - DAY

Dr. Wright and her team present Amelia to the tech community. Amelia interacts with the crowd, answering questions and making jokes. The audience is amazed by her abilities.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Wright and Amelia work late into the night, discussing philosophy and art. Amelia surprises Dr. Wright by playing a beautiful melody on the piano.

DR. LIZ WRIGHT
(Touched)
You've got a soul, Amelia.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Dr. Wright sits at her desk, staring at a photo of her and her husband. She smiles, realizing that she's finally found a worthy successor.

FADE OUT.

THE END
